name: Rawal Dam spillway
assumptions: Eight bays: Dawn (Jun 2016 photo caption) states eight gates and three photos show seven piers between two abutments; the dossier's six was a low-confidence count.

The crest follows the OSM dam line way/238431936 and the deck follows the OSM road way/1046148216 (bridge=yes), about 6 m downstream of that line; the outline's upstream edge therefore falls near the deck, not at the ogee crest.

z = 0 is the tailrace pad. Structure top is 35.2 m (road 35 m) and only the lamp tips reach 40.7 m. The dossier's 40.7 m is the maximum dam height, likely from foundations, so the manifest states the 35.2 m massing height.

In-game levels do not match this structure: the DEM gives about 523.8 m at the model origin, the game's lake about 527 m and the game road about 526 to 530 m, so the game's lake lies near z = 3.5 and its road near z = 3 to 6, far below this deck at 35 m. The real reservoir is about 534 m. No water surface is modelled because it would float; the lake side is a closed concrete wall down to the pad.
Ogee crest 11.5 m below the road, gate height 7.5 m, trunnion position and arm layout are engineering estimates fitted to photos; no drawings were found.
Gates are radial, inferred from the dark diagonal struts on the pier sides in the photos, and are modelled closed.

Pier thickness 2.9 m is about 30 percent of the bay spacing: the near-frontal Dawn 2016 view shows slender piers and open bays, and oblique photos look bulkier because they show the long pier sides. The half-round downstream ends are from Dawn 2020 and APP Aug 2025.
Upstream pier noses (rounded, 5.5 m upstream of the crest), abutment length 6 m and deck width 6.8 m are estimates; the upstream side was not photographed close up.
The curved line on each pier side in Dawn 2020 is modelled as a thin dark rib. The Dawn 2016 frontal view shows flat-topped bay openings, so no arched haunches span the bays.

Chute colour sits between the dossier #7A5B47 (one Commons photo) and the dry chute in Dawn 2016, which reads about #C2B29C through haze; all close photos show it spilling, so streak contrast is kept low.
Chute length and bucket are estimated from photos and the outline depth; the stilling basin and end sill are the plainest form, as no photo shows them dry.
Eight hoist housings, one per bay, read from small boxes on the deck in photos; their exact size and contents are unknown.
East of the gates the crest wall follows the OSM road about 17 m to the bank, with the walkway ledge and three dark recesses seen in APP Aug 2025; its full length and the ledge height are estimates.

Earth banks close both ends of the crest and a grass slope runs down the west side: photos show the hill reaching deck level there, but the game terrain near the dam is only 5 to 8 m above the pad, so these banks stand in for ground the DEM lacks. Their shape is plain and not surveyed.

East terraces are simplified to four stepped walls with soil and bushes and one stair; they lie outside the OSM outline because the photos show them east of the chute, and their 13 m width from the training wall is an estimate.
The tree-shaped lamp and paved Old Picnic Point viewing platform lie outside the modelled structure and are left out.
Lamp posts stand at each pier on the downstream rail, spacing read from photos; the double heads follow the dossier.
